title: Python IndentationError
what: Python uses strict indentation (typically 4 spaces) to define code blocks.
why: Mixed tabs and spaces in the file.
Missing indentation under def, if, for, while, or class.
Accidental space at the beginning of an empty line.
fix: Ensure every line inside a block has identical indentation.
Configure your code editor to show invisible whitespace.
code:
def my_function():
    # Exactly 4 spaces
    value = 42
    return value

title: Python NameError: Identifier Not Defined
what: Python cannot locate the specified variable, function, or module in the local or global namespace.
why: Typo or casing mismatch in the variable name.
Using a variable before assigning it.
Forgot to import a standard or third-party module.
fix: Ensure the assignment statement executes before referencing the variable.
Add the missing import at the top of the file.

title: Python ModuleNotFoundError
what: The active Python interpreter cannot find the requested package or module in its sys.path.
why: Package is not installed in the currently active virtual environment.
Your editor is pointing to a different Python interpreter.
Typo in the package name or module path.
fix: Run 'pip install <package>' in your active terminal.
Verify which interpreter VS Code or your IDE is using.
Check for a virtualenv activation (source venv/bin/activate).
code:
python -m pip install requests
import requests

pattern: indexerror|list index out of range|string index out of range
title: Python IndexError: Sequence Index Out of Range
what: You tried to access an item at an index that does not exist in the list or string.
why: Remember indexes start at 0, so the last valid index is len(arr) - 1.
Loop index overshot the array boundaries.
fix: Check len(my_list) before accessing by index.
Use safe iteration: 'for item in my_list:' instead of indexing.
Use slicing (my_list[:1]) which never raises IndexError.

title: Python KeyError: Missing Dictionary Key
what: You attempted to access a dictionary key that does not exist in the dictionary.
why: The key is absent from the input payload or API response.
Spelling, casing, or whitespace mismatch in the string key.
Assuming nested dictionaries always exist without checking.
fix: Use dict.get(key, default) for safe retrieval with a fallback.
Check 'if key in my_dict:' before direct square-bracket access.
Use collections.defaultdict if building grouped structures.

pattern: cuda out of memory|out of memory.*tried to allocate
title: PyTorch CUDA Out of Memory (GPU OOM)
what: Your model, tensors, and batch activations exceeded the GPU VRAM capacity.
why: Batch size is too large for the available GPU VRAM.
Tensors accumulating in computational graph without .detach().
Model not freed between validation passes.
fix: Reduce training batch size (e.g. from 64 to 32 or 16).
Use torch.cuda.empty_cache() and wrap evaluation in 'with torch.no_grad():'.
Enable gradient accumulation or mixed precision (torch.cuda.amp.autocast()).

title: Java NullPointerException (NPE)
what: Java code attempted to invoke a method or access a field on an object reference whose value is null.
why: Object was declared but never instantiated with new.
A method or database query returned null.
Spring dependency injection failed to wire a bean (@Autowired was null).
fix: Check the exact line number in the stack trace.
Use Optional<T> or explicit null checks.
Ensure Spring beans are registered with @Component or @Service.

title: Java ClassNotFoundException / NoClassDefFoundError
what: The JVM classloader cannot find the bytecode .class file on the runtime classpath.
why: Missing dependency in pom.xml (Maven) or build.gradle (Gradle).
fix: Run 'mvn clean install' or './gradlew build' to refresh artifacts.

title: Swift Fatal Error: Unexpected Nil While Unwrapping Optional
what: Forced unwrapping with '!' was attempted on an Optional that contained nil.
why: Used force unwrapping (e.g. user!.name) on an unassigned property.
IBoutlet connection was disconnected or not loaded.
fix: Use optional binding (if let or guard let).
Provide default with nil coalescing: val ?? fallback.

title: Rust E0382: Borrow of Moved Value
what: You tried to use a value after its ownership was transferred to another variable or function.
why: Passing a non-Copy type by value moved ownership.
fix: Pass by reference (&val) instead of by value.
Implement or derive Clone and call .clone().

title: SQLSTATE 23505: Unique Violation
what: An INSERT or UPDATE attempted to store a value in a column marked UNIQUE that already exists.
why: Record with this email or primary key already exists.
fix: Use ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (Postgres) or ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE (MySQL).
code: INSERT INTO users (email) VALUES ('a@b.com') ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;

title: C/C++ Segmentation Fault (Invalid Memory Access)
what: The program attempted to read or write memory that does not belong to its allocated address space.
why: Dereferencing a NULL or uninitialized pointer.
Buffer overflow: accessing beyond array bounds.
Use-after-free: accessing memory after free() or delete.
fix: Always initialize pointers to NULL or malloc'd addresses.
Use Valgrind or GDB to locate crashing line.

pattern: port is already allocated|bind: address already in use
title: Docker Port Already In Use
what: A container attempted to bind to a host port that is already in use by another service.
why: Another Docker container or local server is running on the same port.
fix: Find and stop process on port: docker ps / lsof -i :<port>.
Map to a different host port: -p 8081:80.

pattern: updates were rejected because the remote contains work|non-fast-forward
title: Git Push Rejected (Non-Fast-Forward)
what: The remote branch has commits that your local branch does not have.
why: Someone else pushed commits to the branch while you were working.
You rebased or amended commits locally that were already pushed.
fix: Run 'git pull --rebase origin <branch>' to incorporate remote changes first.
Resolve any conflicts, then push again.
code:
git pull --rebase origin main
git push origin main

pattern: hydration failed|text content does not match server-rendered html
title: React / Next.js Hydration Mismatch Error
what: The HTML rendered on the server did not match the initial HTML rendered by the client.
why: Rendering client-only values (like window, localStorage, or Date.now()) during SSR.
fix: Use useEffect or a mounted flag before reading window/localStorage.

title: Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff
what: A container in the pod keeps starting, crashing, and restarting repeatedly in an exponential back-off loop.
why: Application threw an uncaught startup exception.
Missing environment variable or mounted config secret.
fix: Check container exit code with: kubectl describe pod <pod-name>.
